Miranda Camilo is a soldier of the UFS.


Personality
Miranda loves to fight and is very upbeat if not rude, even when killing people, nothing seems to bother her. She is very proud of the team, but does not take things too serious. A very individualistic person, which has charisma.

Miranda is perverted enough, to take sexual advantage of her male enemies, even when non-combatants. She often oversleeps and is late all the time, she also is known to skip training and altered her uniform for fun.

Appearance
She has white hair and yellow eyes.

History
Background
Miranda is a soldier of the UFS. She is the leader of the Rabbit Platoon and wears a power suit tailored for her.

She joined the military because she liked fighting, so she had no loyalty whatsoever. However, as much as she likes it, her sense of combat and tactics are also quite good, but it still created issues with the higher ups.

Thanks to her bad attitude, she was thrown out of her last squad and even now is often kept in talks, in which her superiors complain. Her squad is an independent, all-female unit of the UFS. All with customized equipment, all sharing the bunny-like antenna. Before it had the name and design it was a uniform group and Miranda had trouble connecting to her teammates but as she grew bored by the design of the suits, she added details to make it more cool. After a while, other teammates did the same thing, and the group became like a close family.

Timeline TABA
As part of her assignment, Miranda was supposed to enter into a training battle with Shinganji Kurenai, testing new equipment, but she was too late having overslept. Hatsukaze, which had wandered into the base by mistake, was misunderstood by both Kurenai and Makishima Ayame to be part of the rabbit platoon as she was in a rabbit dress, so the battle test started with her instead. As the Miranda arrived, and the situation became, clear, nobody could really remain mad at Hatsukaze. A random group, sent out by Oboro to steal technology, just attacked the base at the same time and with the help of Hatsukaze even their Cloaking tech was useless. As Ayame, Kurenai and Miranda as well as Hatsukaze finished the attackers quickly. Hatsukaze saw a chance to escape and took it, Miranda and Kurenai had a final match for the weapon test, which Kurenai won. However, both had become friends at this point.

Timeline RPGX
Does not appear, but Rabbit Platoon does, with Tina Worrell wearing one of their uniforms at some point.

Trivia
Like Oboro and Mizuki Shiranui, she is seen more in femdom situations.
Though she did appear in RPGX yet her platoon has.
When threatened to be punished by her superior, she took it as an invitation for something else and said it was "okay once in a while", until her boss stated that he meant literal punishment.
